answer.text: No. Do not keep riding with the ABS lamp on continuously above 5 km/h.
The manual recommends not driving the motorcycle while the ABS lamp stays on at higher speeds, and having the brake system inspected and corrected at an Authorised Royal Enfield Service Centre.

policy.text: The ABS lamp should turn off once the motorcycle reaches 5 km/h, and it lights up again when there is an ABS malfunction.

watchouts.text: If the brake system is repaired, use only spare parts that Royal Enfield has approved for the brake system.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not say how long the ABS lamp can stay on before it must be checked.
